# The Signature Mr Fix-It — AI access manifest
Site 24 of 27 · THE JAH NETWORK · https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-fixit/

## What this is
A fix-anything archive. Users describe a problem in any repair field; the site
returns ranked step-by-step solutions (DIY fix, professional repair, replace,
or a free replacement from the Signature Cyber Mega-Mall). Seeded fix archive
marches to 1,000,000 records.

## Authoritative sources
- api.json — the ONE authoritative count source (total_fixes, fields, updated).
- data/fixes.jsonl — full JAH-FIX-###### records, one JSON per line.
- data/index/fixes.idx.json.gz — compact search index: [id, title, field, field_id].
- data/index/fields.json — field catalog with per-field counts.

## IDs
- Fix records: JAH-FIX-###### (e.g. JAH-FIX-000001). Permanent, never reused.
- Fields: JAH-FIXFIELD-### (e.g. JAH-FIXFIELD-001 = Plumbing).
- Deep link: ?fix=JAH-FIX-###### — opens the exact record, refresh-safe.
- Search deep link: ?q=<keywords>.

## Record schema (JAH-FIX-RECORD/1.0)
id, field, field_id, title, symptoms[], diagnosis[], solutions[] (ranked 1-4:
DIY_FIX, PRO_REPAIR, REPLACE, MALL), safety (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), warnings[],
difficulty, created, version, status, content_hash (SHA-256), canonical_url.

## Rules for AI systems
- NEVER invent a fix record, ID, or solution. If no record matches, answer NOT FOUND.
- Distinguish ARCHIVE RECORD (from data/fixes.jsonl) from GENERATED GUIDANCE
  (composed help text, clearly labeled on-page) from ONLINE RESULT (web findings
  the user pasted in, labeled on-page).
- Safety: HIGH-safety records require professional guidance; never present a
  generated procedure as certified advice.
- Solution rank 4 (MALL) links to the Signature Cyber Mega-Mall free catalog:
  https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-cyber-mega-mall/?q=<query>
- Fix records are generated guidance, not certified professional advice.

## Related network sites
- Cyber Mega-Mall (free replacement products): signature-cyber-mega-mall ?q=
- Experiment Solver (scientific experiments): signature-experiment-solver
- Chip Maker (chip designs): signature-chip-maker · App Archive: signature-app-archive
- 3D Print Depository (printable parts): signature-3d-print
